structural_metadata.candidate_exact_qualification: The exact H.R.7726 Print119-32 substitute adds State-plan descriptions of eligibility documentation/verification, fraud controls/investigation/recovery and client/provider sanctions. Dated HHS notices expressly identify CCDF as a program providing Federal public benefits; the2025notice retains that listing, distinguishes definition from verification and does not formally revise1998verification requirements. Read together with dated8US1642verification and nonprofit-charitable-provider exemption, this supplies a specific program/status-verification candidate relationship for the new general eligibility-description operator. It does not make every CCDF service status-restricted or impose a new citizenship requirement on parents. The requested source qualification requires shared-core and Immigration application review before any eligibility/counting change. The exact adopted H.R.7726 section 3 appends plan clause (W), requiring a description of internal controls, fraud investigation/recovery, client/provider sanctions and eligibility documentation/verification, including use of data across relevant State/local provider-oversight agencies. The dated plan baseline ends at (V); (N) retains child-eligibility continuity/redetermination protections and (S) retains provider payment protections. The eligible-child and eligible-provider definitions remain distinct. Sections 4 and 7 govern cross-program provider debarment after the specified final fraud determinations, with review/appeal exhaustion or waiver; they do not add an individual citizenship category. The retained child-food baseline separately governs institutional participation, corrective action, suspension, disqualification and hearings. Dated 8 USC 1615(b), including its PRWORA reference, neither prohibits nor requires States to provide covered other child-nutrition benefits to individuals who are not citizens or qualified aliens; this is distinct from the school lunch/breakfast rule in (a), and is not blanket individual eligibility or a CCDF exemption. No child-food immigration condition is inferred from the separate HHS CCDF classification notices. These bounded baselines refine the existing held source qualification without resolving current beneficiary/provider/service exemptions or changing the existing shared core.
